description: You are delicate , you are a rarity , the people that get it, get it. Happy Q4 🥂 #selflove #selfimprovement #IntentionalLiving #fyp
transcript: You are a rarity. You are a delicacy. You are built with fine precision. You were built to perfection. The people that understand you have a refined palate, they understand nuance. They understand layers. You will find the people like you. There are people that cannot fathom that you live the life that you live because it is foreign to them. It is not for you to over explain who you are. The people that get it will get it. Throughout different seasons you will meet the people that get it, the people that understand the people that will not only elevate you but you will elevate in the process. It's about managing life up and being able to manage life downward.
